records.obligation: Index-level statement only; operator commutation [H, gamma_1] = 0 is the exact instance MAJ-KITAEV-SWEETSPOT-EXACT.

records.name: Exact sweet-spot Kitaev commutators on two modes
records.summary: On the exact Gaussian-rational 2-mode Fock carrier with t = Delta = 1, mu = 0, the Kitaev Hamiltonian is Hermitian, commutes with fermion parity, commutes with gamma_1 and gamma_4, and the bulk invariant is -1.
records.obligation: Fixed L = 2 instance; general L and the BdG spectrum remain imported.

records.name: Imported Ising anyon model and its braiding limits
records.summary: The Ising model {1, sigma, psi} with sigma x sigma = 1 + psi, sigma x psi = sigma, psi x psi = 1 and the R, F data R = e^{-i pi/8} diag(1, i), F = (1/sqrt2)[[1,1],[1,-1]] on the four-sigma fusion space are imported; Ising braiding alone yields only Clifford operations, classically simulable by Gottesman-Knill, so magic-state inputs are required for a complete gate set.
records.obligation: No claim of physical anyon braiding is made; the braid-matrix identities are the open check MAJ-ISING-BRAID-CHECK.

records.name: Exact Q(zeta16) braid identities for the Ising 2x2 matrices
records.summary: For B1 = R and B2 = F R F over Q(zeta16), B1 B2 B1 = B2 B1 B2, F^2 = I and the hexagon equations hold as exact identities.
records.obligation: Run the identities in exact cyclotomic arithmetic; the paper code checks only Yang-Baxter in floating point.

records.name: Exact Yang-Baxter relation for the signed Majorana braid action
records.summary: For 3 to 10 Majoranas the exact signed-permutation exchange action satisfies b_i b_{i+1} b_i = b_{i+1} b_i b_{i+1}, far commutativity, and composition with its inverse gives the identity.
records.obligation: Fixed counts 3..10; this is the Majorana exchange action, not the Ising 2x2 representation.

records.name: Parity observable bookkeeping is algebraic consistency only
records.summary: That a Z2 parity operator squares to I and commutes with an effective Hamiltonian is checked as an algebraic property of declared finite matrices; capacitance shifts C_Q and reflectometry signals stay external models and do not establish protection or coherence.
records.obligation: No experimental readout model is derived.

records.name: Exact parity-sector splitting on the 2-mode Fock carrier
records.summary: On the exact 2-mode Fock carrier the parity operator restricts to 2-dimensional even and odd sectors, and restricting gamma_1 to a sector is refused because it mixes sectors.
records.obligation: Fixed 2-mode instance; the paper code's ParityAlgebraModel check is floating point.

records.name: Sign-reversing pairs cancel in a signed sum
records.summary: For a natural weight w and integer signs with s1 + s2 = 0, w s1 + w s2 = 0 in Int.
records.obligation: Single pair only; no global involution on a configuration space is constructed.

records.name: GIN fermion-recovery routing rule
records.summary: evaluate_gin_fermion_recovery routes an invalid index to ClosureFailure, a valid index with zero uncancelled sign mass to Repair, and positive mass to SplitBrainRefusal.
records.obligation: The three lemmas unfold this rule; the Repair label is a routing tag, not a sign-problem solution.

records.name: Continuous-to-discrete transfer envelope under quasiparticle poisoning
records.summary: For four MZMs under a Lindblad braiding model with gap Delta, length L/xi and poisoning rate Gamma_qp > 0, the trace-norm transfer defect obeys Delta_transfer(T) <= min(1, C_LZ (hbar/(Delta T))^2 + (Delta/hbar) e^{-L/xi} T + 1 - e^{-Gamma_qp T}) for T >> hbar/Delta, and that envelope has a positive minimum.
records.obligation: Derive the envelope from the Lindblad equation; a positive physical lower bound on Delta_transfer needs an independent argument, as the source notes.

records.name: Non-Markovian bosonic-bath transfer envelope
records.summary: For a bath J(w) = 2 pi alpha w_c^{1-s} w^s e^{-w/w_c}, the envelope C_LZ (hbar/(Delta T))^2 + A_s T^p has minimizer T* = (2 C_LZ hbar^2 / (p A_s Delta^2))^{1/(p+2)}, a positive minimum for alpha > 0, and exponent beta = 2/(p+2).
records.obligation: Derive the bath term A_s T^p and p(s) from the spectral density; the calculus minimization of the stated envelope is not written out.

records.name: Multi-terminal cross-junction transfer envelope under disorder
records.summary: For an M-terminal junction (M >= 4) with Delta_eff = Delta_0 (1 - sigma_V/sigma_crit), the transfer envelope adds C(M,2) >= 6 pairwise splitting channels, its minimum rises with sigma_V on (0, sigma_crit), and the gap closes for sigma_V >= sigma_crit.
records.obligation: Derive the envelope and the monotonicity in sigma_V; the gap-degradation law is posited.

records.name: Natural-number positivity lemmas cited for the transfer envelopes
records.summary: Over Nat: products and sums of positive naturals are positive, p > 0 gives p + 2 > 0, p > q gives p + 2 > q + 2, M >= 4 gives M (M - 1) / 2 > 0, and a > b gives a - b > 0.
records.obligation: These lemmas do not bear on any physical envelope; MAJ-C18..C20 stay open.

records.name: Exact rational l1 LP dual lower bounds for Phi1
records.summary: Exact rational l1 linear programming with dual certificates may give certified lower bounds on the F2 coset weight, certifying cosets beyond the search budget where they meet the capped upper bound and reporting the gap otherwise.
records.obligation: No LP relaxation or dual certificate for the F2 coset weight is implemented in this source.

records.name: Evidence adequacy of laboratory measurement maps
records.summary: Whether a declared laboratory protocol's measurement map M separates topological zero modes from trivial Andreev bound states, i.e. whether rho_topo - rho_ABS lies outside ker M.
records.obligation: Requires a declared device model and measurement map; none is supplied.

records.name: Self-consistent Poisson-Schrodinger junction solver
records.summary: A self-consistent 3D Poisson-Schrodinger solver coupling gate geometry, dielectric screening and subband chemical-potential pinning to evaluate phase-boundary shrinkage in multi-terminal junctions.
records.obligation: Listed as the next test; no solver exists in this checkout.

records.name: Canonical anticommutation relations on the exterior Fock space
records.summary: On an admitted N-dimensional complex inner-product space V with orthonormal basis e_i, creation c_i^dagger = e_i wedge - and interior annihilation c_i on the exterior algebra of V (dimension 2^N) satisfy {c_i, c_j} = 0 and {c_i, c_j^dagger} = delta_ij; in particular (c_i)^2 = 0.
records.obligation: Mechanize the CAR identities on the exterior algebra; the statistics choice (exterior versus symmetric algebra) is an admitted postulate, and identifying modes with spin-1/2 particles needs the relativistic spin-statistics theorem, outside this finite setting.

records.name: Jordan-Wigner parity sign of an occupation-basis hop
records.summary: In the increasing occupation ordering on 6 modes, the sign of the hop c_target^dagger c_source on every occupation bitmask equals the product of the Jordan-Wigner parities of the annihilation and the creation step, checked exhaustively over all 2^6 states and ordered mode pairs.
records.obligation: The general Jordan-Wigner bijection c_j = (prod_{k<j} -sigma^z_k) sigma^-_j between spin-1/2 chains and CAR operators is a standard result imported here, not derived or mechanized in this checkout.

records.name: Majorana decomposition, Clifford relations and fermion parity
records.summary: For N CAR modes, gamma_{2j-1} = c_j + c_j^dagger and gamma_{2j} = -i(c_j - c_j^dagger) are self-adjoint with {gamma_a, gamma_b} = 2 delta_ab, generate the Clifford algebra on 2N generators, and P = prod_j (-i gamma_{2j-1} gamma_{2j}) is the fermion parity (-1)^N_op.
records.obligation: Standard algebra imported, not derived here; the trunk mechanizes only the two-generator case (DS-QM212-MAJORANA-PROBLEM). Parity superselection is a physical postulate, not a consequence of the algebra.

records.name: CAR kinematics do not select a fermionic Hamiltonian
records.summary: The CAR constrain the operators c_i, not the Hamiltonian: H = 0, free hopping -t sum c_i^dagger c_j and the Hubbard H(t, U) are distinct Hermitian number-conserving operators on the same CAR Fock space, so a physical Hamiltonian is an added admission (explicit 2-site Hubbard matrix computed by hand).
records.obligation: Hermiticity, number conservation, a locality graph, a one- and two-body truncation and the interaction U remain explicit admissions in every downstream sign record.

records.name: Closed-path series for a signed hopping Hamiltonian
records.summary: For a finite self-adjoint H with H_xx = V_x, H_xy = -a_xy (-1)^{eps_xy} (a_xy > 0, eps symmetric), beta >= 0 and E* >= max V_x, Z = e^{-beta E*} sum_m beta^m/m! sum over closed length-m configuration paths of prod K_{x_{j+1} x_j} with K = E* I - H, and each nonzero closed term has sign (-1)^{sum of eps along the path}.
records.obligation: The sign of a closed term is a property of the supplied magnitudes, parities and representation; vertex sign gauges remove all negative entries exactly when every configuration cycle is even (FSP-SWITCHING-NORMAL-FORM). Trotter slicing and its error are separate.

records.name: Average sign and free-energy gap of a declared representation
records.summary: For a declared path representation with weights W(c), <Sign> = Z / Z_abs with Z = sum sigma(c)|W(c)| and Z_abs = sum |W(c)|; when Z > 0, Delta f := -(1/(beta N)) log <Sign> >= 0, so <Sign> = exp(-beta N Delta f) holds by definition.
records.obligation: Exponential decay in beta N is a hypothesis (Delta f bounded below by a positive constant uniformly in N and beta), not a theorem; Z_abs is an operational absolute ensemble, not in general a physical bosonic system.

records.name: Variance of the Monte Carlo sign estimator
records.summary: For M_s independent samples from |W|/Z_abs, the sign mean has variance (1 - <Sign>^2)/M_s, so relative error epsilon needs M_s >= (1 - <Sign>^2)/(epsilon^2 <Sign>^2); if <Sign> = exp(-beta N Delta f) this is Omega(exp(2 beta N Delta f)).
records.obligation: Correlated Markov-chain samples, observable numerators and the extensive-gap hypothesis need separate treatment; this bound concerns direct reweighting only, not every estimator or representation.

records.name: Representation-dependent negativity on the free triangle
records.summary: For the 3-site spinless triangle, t = 1, U = 0, two fermions, beta = 2 and three Euler slices, the occupation-basis expansion has 27 paths, 6 negative of weight 8/27 and positive weights in {4/9, 1}, so no equal-weight pairing exists there; in the one-body eigenbasis H is diagonal with E in {-1, -1, 2} and Z = 2e^2 + e^-4.
records.obligation: Frustration alone does not imply disjoint weight spectra or hardness (ledger GIN-C4, INV-DISJOINT-SPEC); the general Lean lemma covers only the step from disjoint spectra to no weight-preserving sign-reversing involution.

records.name: Troyer-Wiese worst-case reduction (imported)
records.summary: Troyer-Wiese (2005): the NP-complete decision whether a 3D +-J Ising spin glass has ground energy below a threshold reduces in polynomial time to estimating the thermal energy of the frustrated quantum model -sum J_ij sigma^x_i sigma^x_j at beta J >= N ln 2 + ln(12N); a deterministic polynomial estimator for that family would give P = NP, a randomized one NP subset of BPP.
records.obligation: This is a worst-case statement about a model family under a precision promise; it is not formalized here, is not a reduction to the Hubbard model, and does not make any fixed finite system or every fermionic Hamiltonian intractable.

records.name: Sign-reversing equal-weight involution pairs cancel
records.summary: For any carrier with weights in N and signs +-1, an involution tau with w(tau c) = w(c) and sign(tau c) = -sign(c) has no fixed point and each pair satisfies w(c) sign(c) + w(tau c) sign(tau c) = 0; zero signed sum does not require such a pairing (+2, -1, -1), and a cancelling doublet can carry a nonzero observable numerator.
records.obligation: Summing pairs to get sum_c w(c) sign(c) = 0 on a finite set is a prose orbit-partition step (manuscript Section 4.2), not mechanized; observable numerators need A o tau = A; the involution is sufficient, not necessary (INV-INVOL-CANC).

records.name: GIN equal-weight pairing on the four-site ring fixture
records.summary: For the four-site periodic ring, U = 0, two spin-up fermions, beta = 3/2 and four Euler slices, all 32 negative Euler-transfer paths are matched to disjoint positive paths of exactly equal rational weight within one weight fiber, and a posting-list query over k modes uses k posting-list operations.
records.obligation: Pairing is on exact weight fibers of enumerated paths, not a spectator-preserving symmetry (INV-GIN-PARITY); it does not preserve general observables, and path enumeration grows exponentially. CT-AUX update stability for multi-orbital models has no evidence here.

records.name: Rational cochain quotient normal form
records.summary: For d0 in Q^{m x n} and W = im d0, N_W(x) = x - sum_i x_{p_i} r_i (nonzero RREF rows r_i of d0^T with pivots p_i) is sound, idempotent and complete for x ~ y iff x - y in W, and is independent of the generating matrix; Lean checks the three laws for the fixed integral image span(1, 2) in Z^2.
records.obligation: N_W is not an l1 minimizer (span(1,2), x = (1,0) gives norm 2 versus 1); the quotient norm is a separate exact linear program with a refusal budget (NF-003). A valid YAML contract or routing label is not a normalizer.

records.name: Compact lattice U(1) Wilson action gauge invariance
records.summary: With link phases U_ij = exp(i A_ij) and oriented plaquette products U_p, the Wilson action S = beta_g sum_p (1 - Re U_p) is invariant under local U(1) gauge transformations and nonnegative.
records.obligation: Standard lattice-gauge fact imported, not established in this checkout; the source supplies no fermion-sign consequence for it.

records.name: Wilson-Dirac gamma5-hermiticity and real determinant
records.summary: The Wilson-Dirac operator satisfies gamma5 D_W gamma5 = D_W^dagger, so its nonreal eigenvalues come in conjugate pairs and det D_W is real; for two degenerate flavors det(D_W)^2 >= 0.
records.obligation: A single-flavor det D_W can be negative; the JSONL claim that det D_W is nonnegative is only the two-flavor square. Not established in this checkout.

records.name: Topological theta term makes lattice weights complex
records.summary: Adding S_theta = i theta Q_top with real lattice charge Q_top multiplies the Boltzmann weight by exp(-i theta Q_top), which is nonreal unless theta Q_top lies in pi Z for every configuration, so positive-weight importance sampling is lost for generic theta != 0.
records.obligation: Severity of the resulting sign problem is phenomenology from the literature; the checkout has no theta-term model.

records.name: Callan-Harvey anomaly inflow on a finite slab lattice
records.summary: Claimed: on a finite slab lattice the chiral variation of the boundary fermion determinant cancels the bulk Chern-Simons variation; no lattice construction or cancellation computation exists in this checkout.
records.obligation: Construct a finite slab Dirac operator, compute both variations and show cancellation; the continuum Callan-Harvey mechanism is literature, its finite-lattice form is not established here.

records.name: SU(2) adjoint fermions have a real determinant
records.summary: For lattice SU(2) with Dirac fermions in the real adjoint representation, an antiunitary symmetry of the Dirac operator makes det D_adj real for every gauge configuration.
records.obligation: For a single Majorana adjoint flavor the measure is a Pfaffian whose sign can change; reality is not positivity. Not established in this checkout.

records.name: Complex quark determinant at real chemical potential
records.summary: For lattice Dirac operators with chemical potential, gamma5 D(mu) gamma5 = D(-mu*)^dagger, hence det D(mu)^* = det D(-mu*); for real mu != 0 this relates D(mu) to D(-mu) only and det D(mu) is in general complex.
records.obligation: Standard identity imported; the checkout has no SU(3) staggered operator and no computation of det D(mu).

records.name: Z3 center projection and baryon triality
records.summary: Claimed: averaging over Z3 center phases cancels the signs of fractional-triality quark paths and leaves color-singlet zero-triality contributions; no model, projection identity or computation for this exists in this checkout.
records.obligation: State the canonical-ensemble center projection as an identity on a declared lattice model and show which signs it removes; ledger GIN-C10 and GIN-C11 withdraw the fixture reading.

records.name: Real determinant at imaginary chemical potential
records.summary: At mu = i mu_I with real mu_I, gamma5 D(i mu_I) gamma5 = D(i mu_I)^dagger, so det D(i mu_I) is real; nonnegativity needs two degenerate flavors (or a staggered operator m + K with K anti-Hermitian, m > 0), and Z(mu_I) has Roberge-Weiss periodicity 2 pi T / 3.
records.obligation: Analytic continuation from imaginary to real mu is an extrapolation, not a sign-free route to real mu; not established in this checkout.

records.name: Lattice Wess-Zumino supercharge algebra
records.summary: Claimed: a finite-lattice 2D N=1 Wess-Zumino model with supercharges obeying {Q_a, Q_b} = 2 delta_ab H, H >= 0 and exact boson-fermion pairing of nonzero levels; no such lattice construction exists in this checkout, and lattice discretizations generally keep at most a subalgebra exact.
records.obligation: Specify the lattice model and which supercharge is exact; prove H = Q^2 or {Q, Q^dagger} on the finite Hilbert space before using pairing.

records.name: Nicolai map sign elimination (unsupported)
records.summary: Claimed: on an off-shell supersymmetric lattice model the map xi = -partial^2 phi + W'(phi) has Jacobian equal to the fermion determinant and turns the partition function into a Gaussian with no sign problem; nothing in this checkout constructs the map or the Jacobian identity.
records.obligation: Give the lattice model, prove det(d xi / d phi) = det D_F, and treat the sign of det D_F and the multiplicity of the map; Nicolai-map results are model specific in the literature.

records.name: Witten index beta-independence under exact supersymmetry
records.summary: On a finite-dimensional graded Hilbert space with an exact supercharge Q and H = {Q, Q^dagger}, positive-energy levels pair bosons with fermions, so W = Tr[(-1)^F exp(-beta H)] = n_B(E=0) - n_F(E=0) for every beta, and unbroken supersymmetry has ground energy 0.
records.obligation: Standard result imported; it presupposes an exact lattice supercharge, which FSP-DERIV-040 leaves open, and gives no sign-free sampling of Z itself.

records.name: Kitaev honeycomb exact Majorana solution
records.summary: Kitaev (2006): in the four-Majorana representation of the honeycomb model, the plaquette fluxes W_p commute with H and with each other, and in each flux sector H is quadratic in the c Majoranas with a static Z2 gauge field (after projection to the physical subspace).
records.obligation: A sign-free sampling claim for this representation is not made or checked here; the gauge projection and flux-sector sum must be kept explicit.

records.name: Laughlin quasihole exchange phase pi/m
records.summary: Arovas-Schrieffer-Wilczek: adiabatic exchange of two quasiholes in the nu = 1/m Laughlin state gives statistical phase theta = pi/m.
records.obligation: No Berry-phase or torus computation is in this checkout; the local module fixes m = 3 and checks numeric constants only (ledger GIN-C16 withdraws its reading).

records.name: Fibonacci anyon fusion and braiding data
records.summary: The Fibonacci category has fusion tau x tau = 1 + tau, quantum dimension d_tau = (1 + sqrt 5)/2 (irrational), F and R matrices solving the pentagon and hexagon equations, and three-anyon braids generate a dense subgroup of SU(2) (Freedman-Larsen-Wang).
records.obligation: The JSONL calls d_tau rational, which is false; the claim that braiding avoids sign degradation has no content here. Exact ribbon data are pinned elsewhere in the trunk (TFQ-0050), not in this package.

records.name: BF and 2-group anomaly sign cancellation (unsupported)
records.summary: Claimed: in BF theory on finite cell complexes, the Postnikov class in H^3(G, A) governs cancellation of higher 2-group sign anomalies on knotted worldsheets; no BF model, linking computation or cancellation identity exists in this checkout.
records.obligation: Define the finite BF or 2-group gauge model, compute the 3-loop braiding phases and state exactly which weights become nonnegative; ledger GIN-C19 to GIN-C21 withdraw the fixture readings.

records.name: Cobordism invariant as intrinsic sign obstruction (unsupported)
records.summary: Claimed: a 4D boundary fermion theory with nontrivial invariant exp(2 pi i eta) in Omega_5^Spin(B Z2) has an unremovable sign problem curable only by a 5D bulk; no computation of the bordism group, eta invariant or sign obstruction exists in this checkout.
records.obligation: Relate the anomaly invariant to the sign of a declared finite representation and rule out every representation in a stated class; anomaly-based intrinsic sign results in the literature are class specific.

records.name: Regge deficit angles and action
records.summary: On a 4D triangulation with squared edge lengths, the deficit angle at a hinge h is epsilon_h = 2 pi - sum of dihedral angles at h and the Regge action is S = sum_h A_h epsilon_h; its convergence to the Einstein-Hilbert action under refinement is a literature result imported here.
records.obligation: Regge calculus carries no fermion-sign content in this package; Lorentzian signature, convergence conditions and any sign consequence need separate evidence (ledger GIN-C13).

records.name: Discrete Wheeler-DeWitt constraint on triangulations
records.summary: Claimed: a discrete Wheeler-DeWitt operator H_perp on spatial triangulations is nonnegative and acts as a projection on diffeomorphism-invariant states; no such operator is constructed here, and the DeWitt supermetric of the continuum constraint is indefinite.
records.obligation: Construct H_perp on a declared finite state space and determine its spectrum; the manuscript separates the constraint H_perp Psi = 0 from thermal Hamiltonians (Section 2.5).

records.name: Pachner-move invariance of a triangulation sum (unsupported)
records.summary: Claimed: a discrete topological partition function on 4D triangulations is invariant under the 1-5, 2-4 and 3-3 Pachner moves; the source names no state-sum model, and the Regge action itself is not Pachner invariant.
records.obligation: Fix a state-sum model (for example a Crane-Yetter type sum) and check its move invariance; nothing here bears on fermion signs.

records.name: CDT causal foliation and positive transfer matrix (unsupported)
records.summary: Claimed: a global proper-time foliation in CDT forbids spatial branching, removes Lorentzian cancellations, yields a sign-free positive transfer matrix and a 4D de Sitter universe; the de Sitter phase is numerical literature and the checkout has no transfer-matrix or positivity computation.
records.obligation: Positivity in CDT uses a Wick rotation of a declared action; derive it for a declared finite model and keep numerical phase results as external evidence.

records.name: Dirac-Kaehler tastes and spinfoam boundary signs (unsupported)
records.summary: Claimed: Dirac-Kaehler fermions on simplicial lattices give 2^(D/2) flavors and EPRL-FK boundary contractions yield nonnegative spin-network weights; the only local content is the count 1+4+6+4+1 = 16 = 4 x 4 in D = 4, and no spinfoam amplitude is evaluated.
records.obligation: Evaluate EPRL-FK boundary contractions on a declared finite complex and determine their signs; the taste count is standard and carries no positivity.

records.name: X-cube fracton model ground-state degeneracy
records.summary: Vijay-Haah-Fu (2016): the X-cube model on an Lx x Ly x Lz periodic cubic lattice has pairwise commuting vertex and cube terms and ground-state degeneracy 2^(2Lx + 2Ly + 2Lz - 3).
records.obligation: Imported literature result; the checkout has no X-cube stabilizer computation, and it has no fermion-sign consequence by itself.

records.name: X-cube excitation mobility classes
records.summary: In the X-cube model isolated fractons are immobile, fracton dipoles move within planes (planons) and lineons move only along lattice axes.
records.obligation: The claim that these constraints suppress sign-inducing braids has no evidence here and is left open.

records.name: Hinge-lineon fermion sign elimination (unsupported)
records.summary: Claimed: lineons confined to 1D hinge lines cannot exchange without collision, so their worldlines carry no nontrivial permutations and foliated fracton models are sign free; no model, path expansion or sign computation exists in this checkout.
records.obligation: Give a fermionic fracton Hamiltonian, its declared representation and show all path weights nonnegative, including lineons on intersecting hinges; ledger GIN-C24 withdraws the fixture reading.

records.name: Involution-or-NP-hard dichotomy for finite systems (refuted as stated)
records.summary: The claimed dichotomy (each finite quantum system either admits a certified sign-eliminating involution found in polynomial time or is an NP-hard sign obstruction) fails as stated: NP-hardness is a property of input families, the free triangle has no equal-weight involution in its declared basis yet is solved by one-body diagonalization, and zero signed mass need not come from an involution.
records.obligation: The open research content is FSP-EFFICIENT-SAMPLING-OBLIGATIONS: for a stated model family and input encoding, separate exact finite identities, protected sign-free representations, efficient samplers and worst-case hardness.
